title: model-router query, contract version 1
description: The query shape accepted by model-router contract 1. Input is strict: a field the contract does not define is invalid. A query must carry at least one of task or minimums, which also covers the rule that a pin needs one of them.

task.description: A work need declared in the registry's tasks section.

minimums.description: Inline floors: a rating name to a minimum number. A rating the registry does not declare makes every route count as below that floor, with a warning.

effort.description: A requested effort level. This release accepts any string and applies none; the ladder is checked when effort resolution ships.

pin.description: A route label the caller wants first; needs task or minimums alongside it.

stakes.description: Selects a task's floor set; no effect on an inline-only need.

privacy.description: Secret removes every route that is not privacyEligible.

excludeFamilies.description: Families removed as a hard limit.

spec.description: Settled triggers the matching policy when one exists.
